question: At an office Secret Santa, everyone's name goes in a hat and each person draws one at random. As the group grows larger and larger, the probability that NOBODY draws their own name —
choices: hovers around 37% no matter how big the group gets
steadily shrinks toward zero as the group grows
anchorText: The probability converges to this limit extremely quickly as n increases

question: It is possible to remove pieces from a line segment, bit by bit, until what remains has a total length of zero — and yet the leftover set still contains uncountably many points.
anchorText: the Cantor set is an example of a set which is uncountable and has zero measure

question: The famous Mandelbrot set — that iconic fractal — is actually made up of infinitely many completely separate, disconnected islands.
anchorText: Douady and Hubbard showed that the Mandelbrot set is connected

question: Buses arrive at a stop with an average gap of 10 minutes between them (the gaps vary in length). If you turn up at a completely random moment, your average wait will be LONGER than 5 minutes — more than half the average gap.
anchorText: the average rider at a bus stop observes more delays than the average operator of the buses

question: In 17th-century Europe, a seriously proposed remedy for a sword or knife wound was to carefully treat the weapon that had caused it — rather than the wound itself.
anchorText: a remedy was applied to the weapon that had caused a wound with the aim of healing the injury
